title: Generator Song
subject: a neighbourhood when the power comes back
caption: Afrobeats. A log drum carrying the bass melody, shakers and congas driving the groove, a clean highlife-style guitar figure repeating, warm synth pads, no rock kit. A smooth male voice sings laid-back behind the beat with light autotune and layered ad-libs answering himself, plus a group vocal on the hook. Warm analog saturation, wide stereo image, danceable and unhurried. 108 BPM, F major. Sunlit, easy, communal.
lyrics:
[Intro - Log Drum]

[Verse 1]
The fridge came back on at half past nine
And the whole street heard it happen
Somebody's speaker found its voice again
Somebody's mother shouted hallelujah

[Pre-Chorus]
Three days is a long time in the dark

[Chorus]
Light is back, light is back
(Everybody outside)
The generator can rest now
We'll dance until it goes again

[Verse 2]
Mama Ngozi's freezer is a graveyard
She's giving it all away tonight
Nobody's going to let good meat
Go down twice

[Chorus]
Light is back, light is back
(Everybody outside)
The generator can rest now
We'll dance until it goes again

[Bridge - adlibs]
(Ehh) (ehh)
(Make we dance)

[Outro]
Until it goes again
Until it goes again
